title: The Horse Park at Woodside

services.name: Horse Trials
services.desc: Eventing is integral to the Park, as both a core element of our history and one of the standouts of our facility’s offerings. We host Horse Trials from Starter through Advanced, as well as clinics, schooling shows and Pony Club events. Our courses have been created by famed international designers and we support cross-country schooling for our membership. Since 2022, Cross-Country course design has been reinspired by Derek di Grazia and Bert Wood. Wood and crew have brought new energy and life to the courses to keep Woodside at the highest caliber of the sport.
